Keys.Name: Keep Original Head On Paper Doll
Keys.Description: If enabled, the paper doll shows your character's normal racial head.

Keys.Name: Hunter's Sight Light Range
Keys.Description: How far your sight reaches.

Keys.Name: Hunter's Sight Screen Tint
Keys.Description: If disabled, Hunter's Sight no longer tints the screen.

Keys.Name: Hunter's Sight Light Color
Keys.Description: The color of the light attached to you.

Keys.Name: Hunter's Sight Tint Color
Keys.Description: The color of the screen tint Hunter's Sight applies.

Keys.Name: Hunter's Sight Tint Transparency
Keys.Description: Opacity of the Hunter's Sight screen tint.

Keys.Name: Blood Sense Detection Range
Keys.Description: How far, in feet, Blood Sense detects living creatures while active.

Keys.Name: Blood Sense Refresh Interval
Keys.Description: How often, in seconds, Blood Sense rescans for targets while active. Raise if you notice lag.

Keys.Name: Vampiric Drain Range
Keys.Description: How far, in feet, Vampiric Drain reaches to drain nearby corpses at once.

Keys.Name: Show Blood Tracker
Keys.Description: Shows a row of ten dots on the HUD tracking your current Blood Points.

Keys.Name: Blood Tracker Position
Keys.Description: Which corner of the screen the Blood Point tracker appears in.

Keys.Name: Corpse Blood Divisor
Keys.Description: Monster/enemy corpses grant (max HP / this number) blood, minimum 1 - lower means more generous corpse draining.

Keys.Name: Desperate Casting HP Cost %
Keys.Description: Casting a blood-costing spell with insufficient Blood Points no longer refuses - each missing point instead costs this percent of your maximum Health, paid directly.

Keys.Name: Dominate Upkeep Divisor
Keys.Description: A Dominated creature's upkeep cost against your shared legion budget is (its max HP / this number) - lower means Dominate can hold tougher creatures for the same budget.

Keys.Name: Allies Ignore Each Other's Collision
Keys.Description: Thralls, created vampires, and Dominated creatures normally jostle for space like any other pack of creatures. Enable to let them pass through each other too, so a large court never jams up a corridor.

Keys.Name: Permanent Dominate
Keys.Description: Dominated creatures never revert to hostile on their own duration expiring. The shared legion budget still applies - a permanent Dominate can still be released early if it's your oldest ally and the budget can no longer hold it.

Keys.Name: Vampiric Flames/Ice Spare Caster
Keys.Description: Vampiric Flames and Vampiric Ice will not damage you, even if you're standing in your own blast.

Keys.Name: Vampiric Flames/Ice Spare Allies
Keys.Description: Vampiric Flames and Vampiric Ice will not damage your thralls, created vampires, or Dominated creatures caught in the blast.

Keys.Name: Allow Daylight Arrival
Keys.Description: Vanilla DFU always force-delays a vampire's fast travel arrival until dusk if it would otherwise land between 6am and 6pm. Enable to allow arriving in broad daylight instead.

Sections.Name: Feeding
Sections.Description: Sneak-feeding on NPCs in homes and inns.

Keys.Name: Sneak Feed Key
Keys.Description: Key used to open the Feed/Pickpocket/Cancel menu when looking at a townsperson indoors.

Keys.Name: Sneak Feed Custom Key Bind
Keys.Description: Custom key bind for sneak-feeding, used if Sneak Feed Key above is set to Custom Key Bind.

Keys.Name: Frenzy Events
Keys.Description: At 0 Blood Points, lingering near townspeople risks an involuntary feed attempt, resisted by Willpower.

Keys.Name: Feed Scene Music
Keys.Description: Fades the game's own music out and a heartbeat track in while a Narrative Feeding Scene is on screen. Disable to keep your normal music playing through scenes instead.

Keys.Name: Feed Scene Voice Acting
Keys.Description: Plays a recorded voice line for each Narrative Feeding Scene message, when one exists for it. Disable to read scenes silently.

Keys.Name: Scene Complication Chance
Keys.Description: Percent chance a feeding scene includes a middle complication beat. 0 means scenes are pure flavor framing with no middle beat.

Keys.Name: Night Walker Count
Keys.Description: Up to this many townspeople stay out on the streets at night instead of all going indoors, giving a vampire someone to hunt after dark. 0 disables this entirely.

Keys.Name: Populate Residences At Night
Keys.Description: Residence interiors normally empty outside their open hours (most houses, roughly 1800-0600) stay populated instead, giving a vampire someone to feed on indoors at night. Player-owned houses are never affected.

Keys.Name: Animal Hunt Cooldown Hours
Keys.Description: Hours between wilderness animal hunt attempts (the feed key's own wilderness recovery valve, when no townsperson is in reach). 0 disables the cooldown entirely.

Keys.Name: Create Vampire Offer Chance
Keys.Description: Percent chance, after a successful non-violent feeding scene, that the victim is offered as a rare Create Vampire opportunity. Checked before the Create Thrall offer below; 0 disables it.

Keys.Name: Create Thrall Offer Chance
Keys.Description: Percent chance, after a successful non-violent feeding scene, that the victim is offered as a Create Thrall opportunity - only checked if the Create Vampire offer above didn't fire. 0 disables it.
